# Epic fixtures

Real, scrubbed Epic responses captured by `npm run epic:probe -- --label <name>`, one folder per run. Phase 1 parser tests read these.

While the repo is public, capture folders are git-ignored, because they hold other players' account IDs and country flags. See "Fixtures and privacy" in docs/EPIC_API_NOTES.md. Never put hand-written data here: synthetic test data belongs in `test/helpers/`.
